# Grenoble Roller Website

> Community platform for the Grenoble rollerblading association: e-commerce shop, events & initiations, memberships (HelloAsso), custom admin panel. Rails 8 monolith, PostgreSQL 16, Devise + Pundit, Bootstrap 5. Docs are French-first (association volunteers); agent-authored artifacts (DRs, runbooks, audits) are English. Gitflow: feature → `Dev` → staging → main.

## Root

- [README.md](README.md): Quick start, roles, Docker ports
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent guide — language policy, doc map, gitflow, stack
